_about: How data.js names map to BSData (wh40k-11e) where they are not the same. Units are found by exact name (after nn() normalisation); only differences go here. units["army/unitId"]: entry/leadsEntry = BSData root entry names, models = {app model name: BSData model entry}, gear = {app gear name: BSData wargear entry}. catalogue = {BSData root entry name: the catalogue it is taken from, when not the faction’s}, entryId = {BSData root entry name: the id of the one of two root entries of that name}. detachments["<detachment id>"] = its BSData entry name.
